https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: Generations routed through a Model Router (/model-routers) are billed at the standard rate of whichever model the router selects. The response metadata reports the model used and the realized cost in credits.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: Kling 4.0 includes audio and has no audio toggle. Charges are rounded up to the next credit. List prices apply from December 1, 2026 UTC. Input video is a video-to-video source or any reference video. Each input clip counts at most 30 seconds, and the combined input is capped at 30 seconds. A video edit uses the source video's length as the output duration.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: gemini_omni_flash_1.2 defaults to 720p. The total output, image, and input-video charges are rounded up to the next credit, with a 6-credit minimum per request. With duration: "auto", generation and extension reserve 15 seconds of output, then settle to the generated duration rounded up to a whole second (3–15 seconds). Extension bills only the newly added output footage, plus the input video. Editing bills the input video's duration at the output rate, plus the input-video and reference-image charges. The calculator below does not include this model's reference charges or mode-specific billing; use these rates instead.
https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: gpt_image_2 is billed as credits per image × outputCount. The auto resolution is billed at the 4K tier. Default quality is high.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: gpt_image_2_5_flare and gpt_image_2_5_sunburst are billed on the same tables, as (credits per image + 1 credit per reference image) × outputCount — reference images are charged once per generated image, not once per request. The price per image depends on the quality, the resolution tier and the aspect ratio of ratio: square images cost the most, and wider or taller ones cost less. With ratio: "auto", the request is charged the 4K square price up front, then settled at the square price of the tier the image was rendered at. Default quality is high.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: gpt_image_2_6_flare and gpt_image_2_6_sunburst are billed on the tables below, at the same resolutions as gpt_image_2_5_flare and gpt_image_2_5_sunburst. high costs the same as on GPT Image 2.5, and low and medium cost more. xhigh and max are not supported. Both models default to quality: "high" and reasoningEffort: "high". Reasoning effort does not change the price. png, jpeg and webp output cost the same. The same reference charges and auto settlement apply, with outputCount from 1–10 (default 1) and a minimum of 2 credits per image. With ratio: "auto", the request is charged 9 credits at low, 16 at medium and 19 at high up front.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: grok_imagine_image_2 is billed as outputCount × perImage + referenceCount × 1. Reference images cost 1 credit each and are charged once per request, not per output image — for example, four 1K medium images with two references is 4 × 6 + 2 = 26 credits. Default quality is medium; anything other than low (including an omitted quality) bills as medium. auto_1k and auto_2k bill at the 1K and 2K tiers. A plain 1K generation is 6 credits (the minimum charge). With outputCount capped at 4 and references at 3, the maximum for a single request is 35 credits.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: ideogram_4_5 and ideogram_4_0 are billed as credits per image × outputCount, at any resolution. ideogram_4_5 defaults to medium when generating from reference images and high otherwise, including preciseEdit; very_low requires reference images and is not available with preciseEdit. ideogram_4_0 defaults to medium.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: ideogram_vector returns one SVG per request. On text to image, it is billed by quality, which defaults to medium. high costs more when the request includes reference images. Converting an image on POST /v1/image_to_vector costs 11 credits, for either vectorizationMode.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: kling_4_flash includes audio at the same price on every endpoint. Input-video duration is the sum of the source and reference clips, with each capped at 20 seconds and a combined 20-second budget. Image references have no separate charge. The total is rounded up once per generation. For example, a 5-second output without input video costs 47 credits; with 3 seconds of input video it costs 63 credits; with 10 seconds of input video it costs 95 credits. The calculator covers only requests without input video. The Kling 4.0 promotion does not apply to Flash.

https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: magnific_video_upscaler_creative is billed per output frame, not per second of video. Credits = ceil(USD / 0.01), where USD = rate × fps × duration_seconds. Minimum 1 credit per generation. When fpsBoost is enabled, output frame count may differ from input and affect cost. Frame-rate conversion on the same endpoint is billed separately — see Enhance Frame Rate pricing (#enhance-frame-rate-pricing).
https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing.md: per second of output at the source's own resolution.
